text:
Maya: Draft of the launch post is in the preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/launch-apr-draft. Need fast passes on: messaging, benchmark callouts, webinar blurb, CTAs and inbound routing. Target publish Tue 10am PT.
Ethan: Nice structure. One ask: can we call out p50/p99 latency improvements in the benchmarks section (one line)? Helps press.
Maya: Yup, I'll pull the latest numbers from the bench spreadsheet this afternoon and drop them in.
Priya: Share the HubSpot mapping here so I can wire forms and sequences.
Maya: Mapping pasted: ```utm_source=product_launch_apr&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=apr_launch
primary_cta=Join webinar -> hubspot_form:WB-2026-01
secondary_cta=Request demo -> hubspot_form:DEMO-456
lead_tags=launch_apr,benchmark_interest
```
Daniel: Uploaded hero image and mobile crop to the preview. Need alt text and two CRO CTA variants (Webinar / Demo).
Sam: Alt text suggestion: "Redwood Inference dashboard illustrating improved token latency and throughput" 1OK?
Daniel: Good. Using that. Also set focal point for mobile crop to the left.
Lena (Legal): Quick legal pass: avoid absolute superlatives (e.g., "fastest"); use "industry-leading" or specific numbers. Also remove any direct endorsements of third-party model vendors.
Maya: Replaced "fastest" with "industry-leading" and stripped vendor mentions.
Ethan: Webinar blurb looks solid. Recommend hero CTAs: primary "Join the webinar" (register form), secondary "Request a demo" (demo form). Keep both for tracking.
Priya: Routing plan: webinar signups -> nurture sequence "launch_webinar_attend"; demo requests -> SDR queue with tag "prod-launch-apr"; benchmark opt-ins -> product-ml mailing list. I'll build the workflows after final mapping.
ops-bot: Preview deploy complete: https://preview.redwood.ai/launch-apr-draft (build #421).
Maya: QA checklist I'm tracking: preview links, SEO meta, image alt text, CTAs wired, HubSpot forms, lead routing, legal quick-pass, webinar registration flow. Anything missing?
Daniel: Meta description missing 1can someone draft <=155 chars?
Priya: Draft meta: "Redwood Inference launches a unified platform to reduce LLM latency and cost. See benchmarks and register for our webinar."
Ethan: Good to me. Approved from product.
Lena (Legal): Legal quick-pass approved with edits applied.
Maya: Added p50/p99 numbers from the latest bench and wired CTAs. Ops, can you schedule publish and announce to Slack channels? Target Tue 10am PT.
ops-bot: Scheduled publish: 2026-04-28T17:00:00Z. Announcement queued to #general and #marketing.
Ethan: :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll follow up to confirm HubSpot workflows are live after publish.
Maya: Closing unless a last-minute blocker comes up. If you see anything in the preview, drop a single-line note here. Thanks everyone!
